description: Test the quality, reliability, and security of internal systems: POS, Backoffice, and Inventory Management.
Run end-to-end manual tests on POS transactions, including dynamic online/offline pricing, promo codes, and payment validation.
Build and maintain Playwright UI automation suites for regression testing on every release.
Test APIs with Postman: payloads, status codes, and business rules.
Found a Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) flaw in a WebView search input that could cause a client-side DoS.
Trace defect root causes through backend logs and metrics in Grafana, and design load tests for race conditions and database bottlenecks.
Redesigned the UI/UX of the agency's WordPress website for consistent visuals and easier navigation.
Published and updated content, announcements, and public information.
Troubleshot hardware and software issues on staff workstations.

about.title: About
about.photoAlt: Portrait of Wahyu Fikri Zeni Putra
about.bio:
I am a software QA engineer and a recent Information Technology graduate. I build end-to-end tests with Playwright, validate REST APIs for functionality, data integrity, and error handling with Postman, and test for broken authentication, access control, and input-validation flaws.

Before QA, I built web apps with Laravel and Next.js. That fullstack background helps me read code, talk with developers, and write bug reports they can act on quickly. I am growing my cybersecurity skills and exploring how AI can make testing faster.
